text:
Maya: Quick sync — large prospect wants a pilot: per-tenant customer-managed KMS, dedicated capacity, and tight latency goals. Need alignment on scope + launch criteria.
Priya: Do we have the exact ask? Are they demanding HSM day one?
Maya: They said HSM eventually but will accept customer-managed KMS for pilot if we provide telemetry and a migration path. Pilot target: p95 200ms for 2k-token gen; p99 is a later goal.
Alex: Infra: we can reserve a dedicated GPU shard and stand up a KMS connector. HSM integration (attestation & rotation) is a separate vendor effort ~3-4w. Network peering + IAM scoping are blockers.
Jordan: Security: pilot can use customer-managed KMS but we must not claim HSM equivalence. We'll need audit-log exports and a SOC2-aligned evidence package. HSM attestation requires vendor certs + legal review.
Sam: Runtime: p95 200ms at 2k tokens is plausible with a tuned model variant + quantization + cache warmup, but p99 150ms is unrealistic on current families. I want to run a perf matrix.
Lee: Product proposal: Pilot MVP = customer-managed KMS, dedicated capacity, soft SLA (p95 target), telemetry, evals, and rollback plan. HSM + hard p99 SLA post-pilot.
Priya: Sales wants pilot in ~8 weeks. If we parallelize work across infra/runtime/security we might hit that for customer-managed KMS. HSM would push past that.
Maya: Agreement: pilot scope = customer-managed KMS, dedicated pool, soft SLA. Post-pilot: HSM + tighter p99 SLA.
Sam: Runtime actions: perf matrix at seq 512/1024/2048, quant A/B, KV cache warmup, p95/p99 under pilot-shaped load. ETA: initial runs in 10 business days.
Alex: Infra actions: draft runbook for VPC peering, dedicated pool provisioning, KMS connector, audit-log pipeline. I'll open infra tickets and PRD. ETA: 8-10 business days.
Jordan: Security actions: gap analysis vs SOC2 and legal checklist for key custody claims. I'll coordinate with Legal. ETA: EOW next week.
Priya: I'll draft the pilot SOW and negotiate dedicated capacity commitment and flexible SLA language.
Lee: I'll run the quality regression harness when Sam has quant configs. Link: https://redwood.internal/evals/tenant-kms (internal).
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PROD-9001 "Tenant KMS pilot preflight" assigned to Alex.
Maya: Risks: 1) quality regressions from quantization; 2) HSM delays delaying contract milestones; 3) latency SLOs slipping under load. Mitigations: eval harness, model fallback, clear customer comms.
Maya: Action owners recap: Maya -> legal & exec messaging; Priya -> customer comms & SOW; Alex -> infra runbook & tickets; Sam -> runtime perf tests; Jordan -> compliance gap doc; Lee -> evals. Weekly checkpoint next Tue.
